item.title: Crane used to bring construction worker down from 17th floor of Sarasota building
item.description: The Sarasota County Fire Department's Special Operations team's "quick thinking" helped rescue a construction worker who became ill while working on the 17th floor of a building under construction in Sarasota last week.

item.title: Sarasota quadruple murder victims identified, linked to double homicide in South Florida
item.description: A shooting that left four victims and the suspect dead in a Sarasota gated community was linked to a separate homicide in Florida, authorities said.

item.title: Man shoots, kills estranged wife, her 4-year-old daughter: Florida police
item.description: A mother and her 4-year-old daughter died after they were shot by the woman's estranged husband, the Ocala Police Department said Wednesday.

item.title: Costco customers stuck with worthless gift cards after company goes bankrupt
item.description: Costco customers in Florida and several other states were left with worthless pieces of plastic in their wallets after a gift card company went bankrupt.

item.title: Sarasota staple, Hob Nob Drive-In, set to reopen under new owners: 'Everybody missed it'
item.description: Hob Nob, a drive-in burger joint had been around since 1957, but it closed in the spring of 2024. Now, the Sarasota icon is re-opening under new ownership.

item.title: 'Do not drive' warning issued for over 225,000 vehicles due to exploding air bags
item.description: An automobile manufacturer that makes cars under the Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep and Ram names issued a "do not drive" warning for over 200,000 vehicles Wednesday.

item.title: Sarasota charter boat captains protest new permit requirement
item.description: Sarasota County charter boat captains took part in a rally Wednesday at Nora Patterson Bay Island Park to oppose a new county rule that they say could hurt the future of the industry.

item.title: Neighbor's frantic 911 call from Sarasota quadruple murder released
item.description: The Sarasota County Sheriff's Office released the 911 call from a neighbor who tried to save one of the victims in Tuesday's quadruple murder.

item.title: Driver dies after Tampa Bay trucker makes illegal U-turn on I-75: FHP
item.description: A driver who was injured in a major crash that shut down Interstate 75 on Monday has died.
